name: ilca-climbing
description: Results, judging and national rankings for the Israel Climbing Association (ILCA): live IFSC-style boulder & lead results, judge pad, history since 2020. React + Supabase PWAs, Hebrew/English.

paragraphs: Results, judging and rankings for the Israel Climbing Association (ILCA, התאחדות הטיפוס בישראל): live boulder and lead results, a judge scoring pad, coach views, the full history of every climber since 2020-21, and the national rankings. Hebrew (RTL) by default with an English toggle. React + Vite PWAs on Cloudflare Pages, data in Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Realtime; Frankfurt).
Both sites are rebuilt from main on every push. Neither is indexed by search engines yet (noindex); see operations for the public launch.
features: Live results in IFSC style (IFSC 2025 boulder points with countback, lead geometric-mean

ranking, classic T/Z for older rounds), updating in real time, with start lists, qualification groups, age-class filters inside combined categories, a men / women (category) switch, "on the wall now" per boulder,…
Judge pad: one climber at a time in start order, large + / − attempt stepper, Top / Zone,

live points, confirmations before locking, auto-advance to the next climber still to judge. "▶ On the wall" shows the public who is climbing now on each boulder (only when the judge marks it or counts an attempt; off on…

requirements.text: Who may do what is enforced in Postgres with row level security; the viewer's bundle doesn't even contain sign-in, judge, coach or admin code.
(men / women) is prefetched so the switch is instant, the public app ships without sign-in code, and the database is in Frankfurt (a full live round page loads in under 2 s from Israel).
